intake.release_requirement: Independent byte-scope and transport review, then root freezes prospective cohort/scope and binds released declaration before any TRAIN payload GET. Existing model output reserve remains active; no generic process-overlap exception.
intake.storage_rule: At start and before each transport attempt, free bytes minus all queued/inflight still-needed bytes minus 64 GiB for active/future model outputs must remain at least 100 GiB. Completed bytes are not double-counted as future storage. Existing partial bytes reduce planned remaining bytes; inflight reservations stay until terminal, conservatively counting up to two growing files twice.

object_contract.checksums: 7,226 author Git-annex MD5E identities agree with the exact S3 version size and single-part ETag. For 396 regular Git gradient blobs, verify both provider single-part MD5 and pinned release Git blob SHA1 framing before publication. Compute local SHA256 for every complete file.
object_contract.transport: Exact HTTPS versionId URLs, no redirects, If-Match, exact response version, size, status and Content-Range for resumed files. Multipart ETags are not whole-file MD5; none is selected.

provenance_limits.biological_overlap: Unknown with existing project cohorts and among upstream aliases. Preserve every existing role and quarantine later discovered protected conflicts before admission.
provenance_limits.disease_and_intended_use: Complementary generic human imaging component candidates, not verified glioma policy cases or retraction/deformation measurements.
provenance_limits.person_source_site_crosswalk: Unknown; published six-site total does not prove this TRAIN split covers all six sites.
provenance_limits.pretrained_exposure: Unknown; no independent-transfer or external-evaluation claim.
provenance_limits.reference_tracts: Algorithm-generated and source-curated; not histological truth or functional indispensability.
provenance_limits.source_ancestry: Retain source pipelines and all known/unknown upstream ancestry. Synthetic/simulator-generated learning is permitted by current steering; this does not establish reference validity or evaluation independence.
provenance_limits.source_missingness: Acquire exactly published files; do not invent 30 bundles per subject or exclude difficult people based on contents.

selection_rule: Every file under derivatives/trainset/ in the pinned 1.1.1 source Git tree, using the author-published TRAIN partition. No image, tract, diagnosis, quality or outcome selection. Keep all 198 TRAIN source identifiers in denominator through later QC. Exclude top-level sub-1001 duplicate and every validset/testset payload.
